Grade: Grade 3

Topic 1.3: Effective

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Effective. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use compound and complex whole class talking to has SPEAKING sentences to link thoughts 

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use compound and complex whole class talking to has SPEAKING sentences to link thoughts 
   In simple words: practise until you can use compound and complex whole class talking to has SPEAKING sentences to link thoughts . Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Effective using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Effective in the examples.
2. Explain Effective to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Effective.
4. Show that you can: use compound and complex whole class talking to has SPEAKING sentences to link thoughts 

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Effective using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Effective important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners listen to others as they share and feelings in a variety of personal experiences on selected ways themes d) listen to concerns and opinions

SECTION: REMEMBER
